lines.beaver_en: What are you going to wear tomorrow? Did you decide?
lines.en: I'm going to wear jeans and a white blouse.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. But it's cold outside tomorrow.
lines.learner: 그럼 목도리를 하고 장갑도 낄 거예요.
lines.en: Then I'll wear a scarf and gloves too.
lines.roman: geureom mokdorireul hago janggapdo kkil kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 넥타이를 맬 거예요. 좋은 식당에 가니까요.
lines.beaver_en: I'll wear a tie, since we're going to a nice restaurant.
lines.beaver_roman: jeoneun nektaireul mael kkeoyeyo. joeun sikdange ganikkayo.
lines.learner: 와, 멋있어요! 무슨 색 넥타이를 맬 거예요?
lines.en: Wow, cool! What color tie will you wear?
lines.roman: wa, meosisseoyo! museun saek nektaireul mael kkeoyeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Blue. What bag will you take?
lines.en: I'll carry a small bag on my shoulder.

lines.beaver_en: We're going to the pool in the afternoon too. Don't forget.
lines.learner: 네, 수영복은 가방 주머니에 넣을 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll put my swimsuit in the bag's pocket.
lines.roman: ne, suyeongbogeun gabang jumeonie neoeul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Will you wear a watch too?
lines.learner: 네, 시계를 차고 반지도 낄 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll wear a watch and a ring too.
lines.roman: ne, sigyereul chago bandido kkil kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What color are the blouse buttons?
lines.en: They're gold buttons. They're in fashion these days.

lines.beaver_en: That sounds pretty. What about shoes?
lines.en: I'll wear sneakers with thick socks.

lines.beaver_en: Great. What time should we meet tomorrow?
lines.en: Let's meet at eleven in front of the school.

lines.learner: 네, 내일 봐요. 늦지 않을 거예요!
lines.en: Okay, see you tomorrow. I won't be late!
lines.roman: ne, naeil bwayo. neutji aneul kkeoyeyo!
